# F8: Fit and finish, sheets

A check of the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/8-sheets.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, sheets (per-area reports, 4 Nov). Sheets and menus: the sticky sheet footer (also Watching/Activity #3 and List #3), tall sheets, messages over a sheet, the walkthrough coach, the Demo menu, the Filter goals sheet, touch targets, focus, empty states and first load.
